hypothesis: ASSUMPTION: all numerical values are PROPOSED ASSUMPTIONS until founder approval. At least 3 of 5 consenting adult participants from this segment: Entrepreneurs investigating an early-stage digital product idea, can describe a concrete occurrence within the past 30 days of this stated problem: Founders may struggle to distinguish supported claims from assumptions and choose a practical next validation experiment, and an action they actually took to address it. This tests a problem-discovery proxy for the founder premise: Entrepreneurs have recently struggled to turn an uncertain startup assumption into a concrete validation experiment. It does not establish demand for the proposed solution.
assumption_under_test: Entrepreneurs have recently struggled to turn an uncertain startup assumption into a concrete validation experiment
untested_assumptions: Entrepreneurs would accept an AI tool that challenges their assumptions instead of agreeing with them
Entrepreneurs prefer a local, open-source tool over a hosted service for early idea research
target_audience: Entrepreneurs investigating an early-stage digital product idea
interviewer_brief: Situation to listen for: Founders may struggle to distinguish supported claims from assumptions and choose a practical next validation experiment. Questions say "this situation" so the participant describes it in their own words; name it neutrally if they ask. Do not describe or show the proposed solution until every question has been answered. A participant with no recent occurrence is a valid result, not a failed interview.
interview_questions: Tell me about the last time, if any, you encountered this situation. What happened?
What steps did you take to address it that time?
Which tools or alternatives did you use, and how did they fit your process?
What time or effort did that experience require?
What, if anything, was difficult about your existing approach?
When did this last occur before that occasion?
What, if anything, have you already tried to change about this process?
validation_experiment: Invite consenting adults from this segment: Entrepreneurs investigating an early-stage digital product idea. Investigate this problem without pitching a solution: Founders may struggle to distinguish supported claims from assumptions and choose a practical next validation experiment. Conduct voluntary interviews about recent actual behavior. Explain the research purpose; allow skipping any question or withdrawing. Keep only anonymous aggregate notes outside this prototype; do not collect identifying or sensitive information. No outreach is automated.

success_criteria.metric: Participants describing a concrete instance within the proposed 30-day recall window and an action they took
success_criteria.label: PROPOSED ASSUMPTION — requires founder approval

failure_criteria: PROPOSED ASSUMPTION until approved: in a completed sample of 5, fewer than 3 qualifying accounts weakens the hypothesis. Repeated absence of the problem or satisfactory existing alternatives also weakens it. An incomplete or biased sample is inconclusive; this kit makes no business gate decision.
recommended_next_steps: Review the hypothesis, audience, constraints and interview guide before recruitment.
Approve or revise the proposed sample size and success threshold before collecting results; freeze the approved version.
Recruit voluntarily through channels you are permitted to use; do not send messages from this tool.
Ask about past behavior before showing any concept. Record anonymous observations, including contradictory observations.
Compare collected observations to the approved criteria and return real evidence to the research workflow.
constraints: No paid AI services or payments
Local artifacts only; founder approval before artifact generation
